speaker: NIST (news release)
verbatim: NIST plans to issue a draft standard incorporating the HQC algorithm in about a year, with a finalized standard expected in 2027.
headline: NIST expects to finalise a standard for HQC, its backup post-quantum key-exchange algorithm, in 2027.
resolution_criteria: Resolves VERIFIED if, by 31 Dec 2027 (plus grace), NIST has published the final Federal Information Processing Standard for HQC (expected to be numbered FIPS 207). There is no partial outcome: a draft is not a standard. NOT_VERIFIED if only a draft exists by then.
